snippet.title: Junkyard Rush Racing Trailer
snippet.description:
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/junkyard-rush-racing/id6689520947 
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.istomgames.motocross 

Junkyard Rush Racing evokes the rugged charm of southern US style daredevil car racing, inspired by the adventurous spirit of "Dukes of Hazzard". Rev up your custom-built engine and rush through the countryside race tracks! Nothing like the open road and a little dust in the air. Feel like a drive?

Navigate through car races in diverse environments including dusty desert roads, ramshackle junkyards, and winding country lanes in Junkyard Rush Racing. Race opponents, complete time trials, participate in tournaments in single player—or challenge a friend for a cutthroat couch multiplayer session by connecting controllers or a keyboard to your device!

Get the wheels turning, don’t let the roadside dust settle!

Available game modes:
• Tournament - play multiple rounds against the same opponents, earning tournament points each round in 3 modes (Race, Elimination and Time Trial).
• Race - play a simple round on a chosen track against 5 cutthroat opponents.
• Time Trial - Beat set track times, or your own best time with each of your cars.
• Local split-screen – Connect external controllers or a keyboard to your device and challenge your friends for a round of split-screen multiplayer car chasing action.

Junkyard Rush Racing is an arcade car racer with
• 16 upgradeable cars (with hundreds of cosmetic options to pimp out your ride to your liking!)
• 12 unlockable racing tracks (Including dirt roads, desert tracks, hilly asphalt roads, rusty junkyards and more)
• Tweakable graphics settings (Get the best performance on your own device!)
• 6 supported languages (Play with an English, German, French, Italian, Spanish or Brazilian Portuguese user interface!)
• 13 boost items to give you an edge over the opposing drivers, or up the ante.
• 3 AI difficulty levels
• 3 camera angles to freely switch between.
• Hundreds of unlockable player avatars.
• Daily missions with large awards, and log in rewards.
• Leaderboards for each individual tracks!
• 10 achievements to unlock.

In Junkyard Rush Racing players have the option to race AI opponents either in a single race or a tournament format, as well as other players via split screen multiplayer. Additionally, players can try to beat their own time on all available tracks in a time trial game mode. Challenge your ability to learn the optimal maneuvering strategies of each track, engage opponents in an intense competition, with a limited nitro turbo booster ability that can be strategically deployed for an advantage in crucial moments.

Your Garage, your rules! Collect all available vehicles from the car shop and customize them with paintjobs, stickers, custom wheels and more; as well as upgrading your engine so your car would perform better on the road. Someone has to show those pesky racers who’s boss!

Set your difficulty between Easy, Medium and Hard modes for a preferred racing experience against AI controlled opponents! Engage in a race against cutthroat opposition, or just enjoy a light friendly match on the open trail—no rush, no pressure, just the humming of your engine.

Change your view to 3rd person, FPS or close up mode - whatever fits your racing style the best! Find your preferred way of tearing up the trail (or the asphalt).

The dirt is calling!  A new challenge awaits every day—are you ready to dominate the racing tracks?
